nodes.title: Introduction to Machine Learning
nodes.description: Comprehensive overview of machine learning as a core discipline in artificial intelligence. Explores how systems can learn and adapt from data-driven approaches.

children.title: What is Machine Learning?
children.description: Defining machine learning and its relationship to artificial intelligence. Explaining how machines learn from data and make intelligent decisions.

children.title: ML vs Traditional Programming
children.description: Comparing machine learning approaches with traditional rule-based programming techniques.

nodes.title: Learning Paradigms
nodes.description: Exploring the fundamental learning approaches in machine learning, including supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.

children.title: Supervised Learning
children.description: Learning with labeled training data, focusing on prediction and classification tasks.

children.title: Classification Algorithms
children.description: Exploring key classification techniques like decision trees, logistic regression, and support vector machines.

children.title: Unsupervised Learning
children.description: Learning patterns from unlabeled data through clustering and dimensionality reduction techniques.

nodes.title: Optimization Techniques
nodes.description: Deep dive into machine learning optimization methods, with a focus on gradient descent and model evaluation strategies.

children.title: Gradient Descent
children.description: Comprehensive exploration of gradient descent as a fundamental optimization algorithm for training machine learning models.

children.title: Stochastic Gradient Descent
children.description: Understanding stochastic variants and their application in large-scale machine learning problems.

children.title: Model Evaluation
children.description: Techniques for assessing model performance, including metrics, cross-validation, and bias-variance trade-offs.

sampleoutline.generationPrompt:
You are a course designer. Generate a structured course outline based on the following information.

KNOWLEDGE TEXT:
Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that focuses on building systems that can learn from data. Key concepts include supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning. Neural networks are a fundamental building block, and gradient descent is the primary optimization algorithm used.

KEY CONCEPTS TO COVER:
gradient descent
- model evaluation

KEYWORDS:
AI, deep learning, algorithms, data science

ACCESSIBILITY MODE: visual

VISUAL LEARNERS prefer:
- Diagrams, charts, and infographics
- Color-coded information
- Mind maps and visual hierarchies
- Images and illustrations
- Spatial organization of content

Generate a hierarchical course outline with:
1. Main topics (level 1)
2. Subtopics (level 2)
3. Detailed points (level 3)

For each node, provide:
- title: Clear, concise title
- description: 2-3 sentence explanation
- estimatedDuration: Estimated minutes to teach this section
- order: Sequential position

Also generate a Mermaid diagram code representing the course structure.
